generation_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a small original editorial cartoon CHARACTER SHEET for a finance explainer, not an infographic or corporate mascot. Exactly FOUR full-body versions of the SAME original adult woman host, in a clean 2x2 grid with generous separation, on a genuinely transparent background. No text, labels, panel borders, shadows, ground, charts or decorative items. Same scale and proportions in all four cells. Large slightly asymmetric oval warm medium-tan head, tiny black dot eyes, expressive simple brows, minimal line mouth, dark brown hair smoothly swept to a SMALL SIDE BUN with a tiny ochre tie. No spiky hair, no glasses. Extremely sparse thin black stick-like arms and legs; tiny simple white outlined blouse torso, no bulky silhouette, fingers only as small practical line shapes. Face about one third of total character height. Flat colour only in face and hair. Hand-inked slightly uneven black contour, a few subtle variations in stroke weight and visible natural wobble; smooth enough to read at mobile size but do not machine-perfect the curves. Minimal pen cartoon, NOT glossy vector, NOT fashionable editorial magazine geometry, NOT 3D, no gradient or texture/noise. TOP LEFT: neutral attentive face, standing balanced with hands resting at waist. TOP RIGHT: explaining with small smile, right arm raised and clearly pointing toward viewer's right, other hand at waist. BOTTOM LEFT: surprised raised brows and little open round mouth, holding one small unlabelled pale paper bill in right hand; thumb and two fingers visibly grip paper edge, forearm supports it, paper may carry only two tiny horizontal ink lines, no lettering. BOTTOM RIGHT: concerned face with gently raised inner brows and downturned mouth, standing with hands at waist. Keep identity and anatomy consistent. Original artwork only; do not reproduce any existing named channel character. Output approx 1536x1536 square transparent PNG.
one_revision_prompt: Edit this original four-pose character sheet ONCE to simplify it substantially for a very sparse pen-drawn explanatory cartoon. Keep the original woman's side-bun identity, four exact pose/expression roles, 2x2 positions, paper grip, and genuine transparent background. Remove ALL skin and hair shading/highlights and gradients: one solid tan face, one solid dark brown hair colour. No texture. Reduce head to a simpler slightly uneven oval with two small DOT eyes, brows, line mouth; remove nose and ears details. Hair is a simple small sweep and bun with almost no internal lines. Replace shirt/body with a single thin black stick torso, thin stick arms and legs, minimal two-line collar only. Remove bulky sleeves, trousers, shoes, full palm detail: hands only tiny line fingers adequate to point and hold the sheet. Preserve balanced knees/feet at bottom; show all feet. Use organic slightly wobbly ink about 3px at 1280 width, varied modestly, no perfect circles. Keep face size and identity consistent across all four cells. The surprised paper-holder must have thumb overlap on near edge and fingers behind the paper, forearm connected to wrist. Much simpler and less polished/mascot-like, closer to a quick original black-pen doodle. No labels, panels, new props, logos or background. Flat opaque colour inside heads only; no glows.
